Jair_1: captured the region of Argob and called it Havvoth-jair (Numbers 32:41)
Abiathar_1: son of Ahimelech, the priest (1 Samuel 22:20), counselor to David (1 Chronicles 27:34)
Jehoshaphat_1: son of Ahilud and recorder in David's kingdom (2 Samuel 8:16)
Zadok_1: son of Ahitub and priest during King David's reign (2 Samuel 8:17), a mighty of valor (1 Chronicles 12:28)
Benaiah_1: over the Cherethites and the Pelethites (2 Samuel 8:18), the fifth of "the thirty" of David's men (2 Samuel 23:20)
Jehoiada_1: father of Benaiah (2 Samuel 8:18), a priest (1 Chronicles 27:5)
Azariah_1: son [descendant] of Zadok, served as priest (1 Kings 4:2) in the temple which Solomon built (1 Chronicles 6:10)
Shisha_1: father of Elihoreph and Ahijah (1 Kings 4:3)
Azariah_2: son of Nathan, was over the deputies (1 Kings 4:5)
Zabud_1: son of Nathan, a friend of King Solomon (1 Kings 4:5)
Nathan_5: a priest, father of Zabud (1 Kings 4:5)
Adoniram_1: over the men subject to forced labor (1 Kings 4:6)
Ben-hur_1: one of Solomon's twelve deputies (1 Kings 4:7), in Ephraim (1 Kings 4:8)
Ben-deker_1: one of Solomon's twelve deputies (1 Kings 4:7), in Makaz (1 Kings 4:9)
Ben-hesed_1: one of Solomon's twelve deputies (1 Kings 4:7), in Arubboth (1 Kings 4:10)
Ben-abinadab_1: one of Solomon's twelve deputies (1 Kings 4:7), in Dor (1 Kings 4:11)
Taphath_1: daughter of Solomon, wife of Ben-abinadab (1 Kings 4:11)
Baana_1: one of Solomon's twelve deputies (1 Kings 4:7), in Taanach and Megiddo (1 Kings 4:12)
Ben-geber_1: one of Solomon's twelve deputies (1 Kings 4:7), in Ramoth-gilead (1 Kings 4:13)
Ahinadab_1: one of Solomon's twelve deputies (1 Kings 4:7), in Mahanaim (1 Kings 4:14)
Ahimaaz_3: one of Solomon's twelve deputies (1 Kings 4:7), in Naphtali (1 Kings 4:15)
Basemath_2: daughter of Solomon, wife of Ahimaaz (1 Kings 4:15)
Baana_2: one of Solomon's twelve deputies (1 Kings 4:7), in Asher (1 Kings 4:16)
Jehoshaphat_2: one of Solomon's twelve deputies (1 Kings 4:7), in Issachar (1 Kings 4:17)
Shimei_3: one of Solomon's twelve deputies (1 Kings 4:7), in Benjamin (1 Kings 4:18)
Geber_1: one of Solomon's twelve deputies (1 Kings 4:7), in Gilead (1 Kings 4:18)
Heman_1: son of Zerah (1 Chronicles 2:6).  Solomon was wiser than him (1 Kings 4:31)
Calcol_1: son of Zerah (1 Chronicles 2:6).  Solomon was wiser than him (1 Kings 4:31)
Darda_1: son of Zerah (1 Chronicles 2:6).  Solomon was wiser than him (1 Kings 4:31)
